acceptance_target: Attempt to produce the next live champion: full four-kernel candidate, exact proof gate, and significant >=3% gain against the champion current at evaluation. Improvement over the shipped reference alone does not satisfy the goal.

collaboration.started_ci_policy: All started CI and experiments finish naturally and are collected; no new research after deadline.

remaining: Rank concrete routes across add/mul/sum/bmm by measured time share times achievable reduction, then development/proof/full-validation cost; no fixed operator order
Single bit conversion bridge remains unaccepted; next minimum fix must use policy-safe allOnes constructor and a fresh full gate
Formal submission, registration and funds outside this window

current_champion_comparison.method: INFERRED: per-class exact-digest historical chain, current champion timing weights, candidate/reference paired class ratios, median over frozen-source full gates. Same-digest promotions excluded; no shared overall multiplier used.

local_project_check.scope: Root and both-track checks;118FloatLibcandidatehashpairs, local links, syntax and manual workflow configuration. Full Lean/gate acceptance separately bound to exact source.

research_resources: Existing Astra R5 turn completed/idle; two web jobs fully recovered and independently byte-checked; no active external research jobs.
selection_scope: BMM-leading complete verified package. No consistent whole-entry improvement over R4 established; current-champion replacement remains unachieved.

optimization_priority.rule: Rank concrete routes by scored-time share times credible achievable time reduction; then weigh development, proof and full-validation cost. No fixed operator order.
optimization_priority.screening: Run the smallest useful complete-cost diagnostic first. Park negligible-gain variants; do not repeat negative routes without a changed mechanism or condition. Preserve proportionate final full-gate confirmation time.
optimization_priority.research_authorization: Priority update only; no new research window, CI, formal submission or funds action started.
optimization_priority.user_confirmed_criterion: 耗时占比 × 可实现的降耗幅度，再考虑开发和验证成本
optimization_priority.gain_formula: For affected scored classes c: expected whole-entry time reduction = sum(w_c * r_c); r_c = 1 - 1/s_c for a local speedup factor s_c. Account for actual hit coverage; avoid double-counting it.
optimization_priority.evidence_requirement: Record measured time share, achievable reduction range and supporting mechanism/diagnostic, coverage, total development/proof/queue/collection/confirmation cost, and next falsifiable check for each route. Unknown gain remains UNKNOWN and gets a bounded diagnostic.
optimization_priority.cost_rule: Compare credible whole-entry gain with total cost and reusable value; no fabricated success probability or mandatory single gain-per-hour score.
